calls.thesis: Post-earnings verdict: supply/demand imbalance persisting through 2028 (mgt says shortages likely to 2029), priced at 5.8x forward PE like a cyclical at peak cycle — DCF fair value $1,439 vs ~$1.1k market price, still undervalued.
calls.bull: Memory shortages persist into 2028-2029, ASPs stay elevated, capex acceleration signals demand visibility.
calls.bear: Cycle turns; oversupply returns and earnings compress as the 5.8x multiple implies.

calls.price_at_call: FV ~$1,430 vs market ~$1,165 (caption-garbled figures); FV to be revised higher
calls.thesis: Reiterating BUY, very high conviction: two straight quarters of 80%+ operating margins (80.7%), revenue $54.2B ~5x YoY, next-quarter guide $61.5B at ~86% gross margin; longer-term customer agreements improving visibility, though current margins are not sustainable long-term.

calls.price_at_call: buyer on pullback to ~$950/share (stated); no current-price buy
calls.thesis: Earnings crushed (revenue/EPS/guide beats, HBM sold forward, supply seen tighter in 2027-28) and thesis is stronger, but stock already ran and prices in the story — enter on a pullback, not at any price.
calls.base_case: AI memory demand + tight supply keep pricing/margins elevated near term; management guides next quarter higher again.
calls.bull_case: AI demand outgrows new supply (HBM/custom NV-HBM integration), so the cycle lasts far longer than prior memory cycles.
calls.bear_case: Memory stays cyclical: new fabs/supply catch up, margins normalize, and a low forward PE proves to be peak earnings.

calls.thesis: Beats across the board but stock flat; owns position, no plans to add — may reallocate to AVGO/NVDA if the 7.2x forward multiple stays 'disrespected'.
calls.base_case: Base: FY27 record revenue, Q1 margin floor at 86.25%, then improving; 26 SCAs de-risk cyclicality.
calls.bull_case: Bull: rerating toward a 'normal' multiple + large buyback authorization (allowed from Dec 9).
calls.bear_case: Bear: 2027-28 peak narrative wins; DRAM pricing turns and margins mean-revert.

calls.thesis: Holding into earnings, expects beats across the board: record scale of revenue/FCF ramp ($168B FCF in FY28 est.) makes 'this time different'; bets $100 on a huge buyback announcement once allowed in December.
calls.base_case: Base: beats and raises; memory upcycle with unprecedented scale.
calls.bull_case: Bull: rerating from 7.4x forward PE + buyback announcement.
calls.bear_case: Bear: cyclical memory turns; margin collapse as in past cycles.

calls.thesis: Undervalued into Sep 30 earnings: unprecedented demand, sold out for 2026 and most of 2027, 80%+ operating margins, forward PE ~6.
calls.bull_case: If market stops pricing it as purely cyclical, multiple re-rates toward 40-50x like non-cyclical growers.
calls.bear_case: Still cyclical at heart; a demand slowdown (not expected before FY2029) would collapse EPS.

calls.thesis: Cheapest of the group by far; house money after taking chips off post-$1,000; expects buyback announced by Q1'27.
calls.base: Memory bottleneck persists; huge FCF generation.
calls.bull: Could buy back 40% of shares by 2028; aggressive price increases ahead.
calls.bear: Margin-peak risk; customers optimizing memory use; new supply.
